sloka: कृत आदेशा भविष्यामि गमिष्यामि सह त्वया ।कालः च अयम् समुत्पन्नः सत्य वाग् भवतु द्विजः ॥२-२९-११॥
transliteration: kṛta ādeśā bhaviṣyāmi gamiṣyāmi saha tvayā ।kālaḥ ca ayam samutpannaḥ satya vāg bhavatu dvijaḥ ॥2-29-11॥

translations.english: I will go with you, true to the prediction of the brahmin. That time has come and let his prediction come to pass.
